scope: Phase 2 web-dyno memory investigation; inventory ATP is separate

production.source: Authorized Heroku Exec inspection after one web-only restart; Linux smaps_rollup and V8 counters from the running process

launcher.note: RSS includes shared pages. Neither RSS nor proportional set alone proves the exact savings from removing npm.

production.allocationSample: A 30-second sampled allocation profile did not identify a single responsible job or establish the history of previously allocated objects.

isolatedComparison.source: One-off Basic Heroku dyno with the production application bundle and Node v24.22.2; credentials scrubbed, schedulers disabled, database set to localhost, and outbound socket connections disabled
isolatedComparison.method: One 30-second run per setting. After five seconds, every 200 milliseconds the probe generated and JSON-round-tripped 30 batches of 500 synthetic rows, retaining only the latest 20 batches. Measurements are for the Node process, not total dyno memory.
isolatedComparison.limitations: This single synthetic comparison is not a production workload or a statistical latency benchmark. It does not establish live savings or guarantee that total dyno memory stays below quota. Monitor memory, garbage collection, latency, errors and sync completion after deployment.
